title: dryopteris viscosa
intro: Dryopteris viscosa, commonly known as Sticky Male Fern, is a species of fern found in various parts of the world. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve respiratory issues, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris viscosa include its anti-inflammatory, expectorant, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as bronchitis, coughs, and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
